title: Mica Diagnostics - on-prem integration ramble
content:
Meeting capture + quick brain-dump (raw)

Call: 2025-02-18 10:00 PT w/ Mica Diagnostics (initial integrator sync)
Attendees: Priya (Redwood), Ethan (Redwood SE), Lena (Redwood AM), Dr. Sana Mehta (Mica CTO), Omar Ruiz (infra lead), Priyanka Rao (security/compliance)

High-level ask
- Mica runs a regulated diagnostics pipeline. They want local LLM assistant to summarize patient-reported symptoms and map to triage codes. No PHI allowed to leave their VPC.
- Goal: on-prem/private deployment behind customer-managed VPC, KMS integration, HSM optional for signing.
- Target latency: 150–250ms token median for short prompts (~100 tokens); throughput target is ~6k tokens/sec sustained across 3 nodes during business peaks.

Notes / constraints they emphasised
- Air-gapped test environment available in their staging datacenter (limited internet). We need an installable package (OCI + k8s helm) that can work offline.
- Strict audit trail: every request needs a correlation id, model version stamped, and immutable logs forwarded to their Splunk instance.
- KMS: they use AWS KMS in a VPC endpoint; for on-prem they want optional Thales HSM for keys.
- PHI handling: PII scrubber in front of calls; also they want a builtin redaction step AND token-level logging disabled for protected fields.
- Patch window: quarterly compliant upgrades (so model upgrades must be opt-in with explicit rollouts).

Technical details they sketched
- Stack: k8s (1.26), NVidia A10G nodes in their private subnet, nginx ingress, Istio sidecar for telemetry.
- Storage: Ceph for persistent volumes.
- Internal auth: OIDC tied to Okta; service-to-service uses mTLS.
- They already run a small micro-batching inference service internally (not Redwood) but it's not optimized for long-lived KV caches.

What they need from Redwood (explicit asks)
- Offline installer + manifest for private deployment (helm + tarball).
- HSM/KMS integration doc + sample config (we need examples for both AWS KMS via VPC endpoint and for Thales HSM PKCS11).
- Audit/logging hooks: must be able to forward structured request/response metadata (no raw tokens) to their Splunk/HTTP endpoint.
- Canary/rollout controls: ability to pin model versions and to do instant fallback to smaller-quantized variant if latency/CPU spikes.
- Suggest quantization profiles vetted for A10G and for their typical prompt lengths (mostly short: 40–150 tokens).
- Prompts + eval harness: they want an initial quality baseline run on a sample of 120 real (anonymized) prompts to compare candidate models.

Gotchas / red flags (from convo)
- Air gap: ask for packaging that doesn’t assume outbound internet (we previously built packages that fetched container images on install; need one-shot bundle or private registry instructions).
- Splunk ingestion: they do not want token-level logs forwarded. We must ensure telemetry config has an option to redact prompt content before forwarding; they also want a hashed prompt fingerprint for dedupe.
- HSM integration is 'nice to have' but they will make it mandatory for production — timeline unknown. Need to estimate extra work for PKCS11 support in installer and for operator runbook.
- KV cache residency: they worry about memory blowups when doing long sessions with long histories (triage sessions sometimes accumulate 5–8 turns). Need to surface cache trimming policies / max-kv-size config options.
- Ops team unfamiliar with Redwood console; they’ll want an alternate CLI-first quickstart and an unattended upgrade path (cronable).

Quick technical followups we must answer (actionable)
1) Do we have an existing offline bundle pattern for on-prem installs (tarball + images) or do we need to build it? (Owner: Ethan)
2) Can runtime disable token-level logging but still emit model version + latencies + correlation id? Need a config snippet. (Owner: Priya)
3) How much effort to add PKCS11 HSM support to the installer and to the KMS adapter? Rough ETA. (Owner: Eng-infra, request estimate by 02/25)
4) Provide reference quantization profiles for A10G optimized for short prompts (LLM-4/2, 8-bit fallback?) and bench numbers on our internal perf harness. (Owner: Applied ML / Priya)
5) Provide an evaluation harness script and sample prompts format they can drop into an S3 bucket or local FS and run offline. (Owner: Ethan)

Immediate next steps agreed on call
- Mica will produce 120 anonymized sample prompts by 2025-02-21 (they said they can do this).
- We'll deliver an offline installer checklist + stubbed manifest by 2025-02-24 (Ethan).
- Priya to draft logging/telemetry config snippet with redaction toggles and fingerprinting approach by 2025-02-20.
- Schedule 1-hr deep dive with Eng-infra + Applied ML for PKCS11 discussion week of 02/24.

Notes-to-self (internal):
- Keep messaging around "no tokens leave customer environment" crisp — they will escalate to legal if wording ambiguous. Use phrase: "no raw token payload is transmitted off-host; telemetry emits only non-PII metadata and SHA256 prompt fingerprint when enabled."
- Consider adding a "redaction filter" plugin hook early in deploy so customer can add custom regex or NLP-based scrubbers pre-runtime.
- Need to capture upgrade freeze windows and how rollback works for offline installs (we should draft an operator-runbook page).

Risks + mitigation ideas
- Risk: HSM integration slips => customer blocks production. Mitigation: deliver KMS-only path first with clear workplan for HSM and offer limited staging access to our KMS-on-VPC-demo to test flows.
- Risk: latency SLO not met on A10G with desired model. Mitigation: propose smaller model variant + quantization + batching/caching recipes. Build a perf report template we can fill for them.

To log in GH/Jira (notes for ticket creation)
- Create MICA-INT-57: "on-prem installer + offline bundle" (Ethan)
- Create MICA-INT-58: "HSM/PKCS11 integration scoping" (Eng-infra)
- Create MICA-INT-59: "Telemetry redaction + prompt fingerprinting" (Priya)
- Create MICA-INT-60: "Perf/quantization profile for A10G" (Applied ML)

Loose ideas for conversation starters in next call
- Walk through canary policy: show how fallback to quantized variant triggers automatically when CPU exceeds threshold.
- Demo a tiny offline install in a VM (screen share) to show installer flow.

Unresolved questions for Mica (we asked live, need answers)
- Confirm the exact Splunk ingestion endpoint and schema they expect for logs (they will send contact).
- Confirm HSM vendor/version they plan to use in prod and whether we can get a test HSM image.
- Confirm PBM for patch windows (they said quarterly, want exact dates).

Miscellaneous scribbles
- They mentioned "triage throughput spikes at 09:00 and 14:00 PT" -> verify with their infra: possibly need burst capacity + autoscale policy tuned to time windows.
- Worth asking legal for sample NDA for handling anonymized prompts in our eval harness.

Action items (short list)
- Ethan: offline installer stub + manifest (due 02/24)
- Priya: telemetry/redaction snippet + internal blurb for legal (due 02/20)
- Eng-infra: PKCS11 scoping meeting + rough estimate (prep by 02/25)
- Applied ML: A10G quant profiles + perf numbers (initial by 02/28)

End of raw capture. Save to MICA tickets; follow up w/ calendar invite for infra deep-dive.

---
